model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, and tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, spanning from 40 to 65, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different method: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, triangle marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond marker, solid line), MEMIT (purple, triangle marker, solid line), and ROME (green, square marker, solid line). The Base line starts at approximately 39 at a Co-occurrence Number of 2 and increases to around 45 at 10^3. The FT line begins at about 40 at a Co-occurrence Number of 2 and rises to approximately 48 at 10^3. The IKE line commences at around 43 at a Co-occurrence Number of 4 and reaches about 50 at 10^3. The MEND line starts at approximately 44 at a Co-occurrence Number of 4 and increases to around 57 at 10^3. The MEMIT line begins at about 43 at a Co-occurrence Number of 4 and rises to approximately 55 at 10^3. The ROME line starts at around 51 at a Co-occurrence Number of 4 and reaches about 66 at 10^3. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend as Co-occurrence Number increases.
